title: Dotted-line sketch of round black object's maneuver path with numbered positions 1–5
description: Typed report from an observer flying a National Guard AT-6 toward Gowen Field who saw a round black object, exposed 8 mm motion picture film, and saw it perform a partial barrel roll. A hand-drawn dotted path shows small circles at numbered positions (1) through (5) rising and curling over the top. The caption explains that positions (1)–(3) show a jerky rising motion, (4) is where it rolled presenting its edge, and it disappeared at position (5).
